rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a person, idea, or matter is pushed aside and given less importance.

example.english: We always relegate this issue to the sidelines instead of dealing with it seriously.
example.traditional: 我哋成日將呢個問題擺埋一邊，唔認真處理。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 zoeng1 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 baai2 maai4 jat1 bin1 m4 jing6 zan1 cyu2 lei5

rows.note: Use this specifically when a sports team is moved down to a lower league division.

example.english: Under league rules, they relegate the team that performs worst this season.
example.traditional: 按照聯賽規例，今季踢得最差嗰隊會降班。
example.jyutping: on3 ziu3 lyun4 coi3 kwai1 lai6 gam1 gwai3 tek3 dak1 zeoi3 caa1 go2 deoi6 wui2 gong3 baan1
